description: Header file defining utility functions for configuring and retrieving environment-specific parameters in the 'cuttlefish' virtualization environment, including instance identification, paths, ports, and support checks.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the instance number based on environment variable or username.

methods.name: GetDefaultVsockCid
methods.description: Computes the default Vsock CID based on the instance number.

methods.name: GetVsockServerPort
methods.description: Calculates the Vsock server port number based on a base and guest CID.

methods.name: GetGlobalConfigFileLink
methods.description: Provides a path to a discoverable configuration file link.

methods.name: ForCurrentInstance
methods.description: Modifies a prefix to make it unique per instance.

methods.name: InstanceFromString
methods.description: Parses an instance number from a string.

methods.name: RandomSerialNumber
methods.description: Generates a serial number with a given prefix.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Provides a default path for host artifacts.

methods.name: DefaultQemuBinaryDir
methods.description: Returns the default directory for QEMU binaries.

methods.name: HostBinaryPath
methods.description: Returns the path to a specific host binary.

methods.name: HostUsrSharePath
methods.description: Returns the path to shared host resources.

methods.name: HostQemuBiosPath
methods.description: Provides the BIOS path for QEMU.

methods.name: DefaultGuestImagePath
methods.description: Returns the default guest image path.

methods.name: DefaultEnvironmentPath
methods.description: Provides a path for environment-specific configurations.

methods.name: HostSupportsQemuCli
methods.description: Checks if the host supports QEMU CLI.

methods.name: UseQemuPrebuilt
methods.description: Indicates whether to use prebuilt QEMU binaries.
